verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Gusto offers health insurance through a SimplyInsured partnership and lists benefits/deductions as part of its platform (gusto-docs-39, gusto-docs-45), but there's no explicit documentation of deduction-to-payroll sync mechanics, and community reports describe real-world friction — inability to customize plans across states, platform lock-in for benefit features like HSA, and a costly failure to terminate a health plan correctly.
